newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in July.
newsitem.headline: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in July.

text.p: Italy had a 6.515 trillion lire trade surplus with non-European Union countries in July, the national statistics office ISTAT said.
ITALY TRADE BALANCE (NON-EU) July 96 June 96 July 95
Cumulative yr to date +25.756 trln +19.241 trln +15.227 trln
Imports yr to date +76.042 trln 65.512 trln 78.366 trln
Exports yr to date +101.798 trln 84.753 trln 93.593 trln
Istat gave the following breakdown for the trade balance with European Union countries for June.
Note: All the figures for non-European Union trade for June 1996 and July 1995 were slightly revised as well as all figures for EU trade in May 1996 and June 1995. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
